title: Authority audit — 'EEO AA plan 2 26 10.doc'
source_path: Affirmative Action Plan (AAP)/AAP Plans (Old)/AAP INFO FY 2011/EEO AA plan 2 26 10.doc
rtec_specific_material: The document opens as a February 2009 RTEC Equal Employment Opportunity / Affirmative Action plan.
It contains RTEC policy, assurances, administration, employment-practice, complaint and program sections.
It names historical RTEC leadership/EEO roles and describes Board, Executive Director and EEO Administrative Manager responsibilities.
mixed_or_external_material: Later portions include generic employment-discrimination guidance and manager Q&A/reference material.
The source contains text referring to the University of California and a Regents resolution, which is not RTEC-specific authority.
The document therefore appears to be a composite of RTEC-adapted plan content plus external/model/reference material.
authority_rule: Do not treat every paragraph in this binary as adopted RTEC policy merely because it is stored in an RTEC AAP folder.
RTEC-specific provisions should be corroborated against cleaner annual AAP versions, signed policies, Board-approved plans or actual process records before promotion to canonical current knowledge.
External/model passages may be retained as historical drafting/reference evidence but should be tagged external_reference_only.
data_quality_implication: This source demonstrates why document-level provenance is insufficient for some legacy Word files. The ingestion pipeline should support section-level authority/provenance and contamination flags.
automation_candidate: Add mixed-source detection to contextual-document ingestion: flag abrupt organization-name/domain changes, unrelated legal frameworks and copied template language for section-level review before promotion.
